name: skill-sherpa
description: Sherpa gives fast read-only content and grammar guidance for saved local document revisions.

interface.shortDescription: A document guide that responds after each save.
interface.longDescription: Sherpa follows saved local document states and gives content, structure, and grammar guidance in one current-host pass without modifying files.
defaultPrompt: Use $sherpa with a local file path to review its content, structure, and grammar in one fast pass whenever it is saved.
Use $sherpa with a local file path and my additional review priorities, without subagents or file edits.
